<warning>The page is photographed rotated 90°, and the print is faint and brownish. The main text is in Uighur-Mongolian (classical Mongolian) vertical script, which can't be reliably transcribed from this image, so it is marked as not transcribed. Only the Chinese marginal title is transcribed.</warning>

<meta>Leaf from a xylographic Mongolian Buddhist canon (Kanjur), in the section of miscellaneous sūtras (Chinese 諸品經, Mongolian eldeb). The text block is printed inside a double-ruled frame. The main text was not transcribed because the image is rotated and faint, so only the marginal titles can be rendered.</meta>

<margin><unclear>short Mongolian marginal title with volume and folio number, in Uighur-Mongolian script, not transcribed</unclear></margin>

<unclear>about 28 lines of vertical Uighur-Mongolian script text, not transcribed</unclear>

<margin>Miscellaneous Sūtras <note>original: "諸品經" (Zhupin jing), the Chinese name for the Kanjur section called "eldeb" in Mongolian, meaning "various" or "miscellaneous"</note>, Volume Eighteen, upper part, folio three hundred ninety-two</margin>

<summary>Folio 392 of volume eighteen in the Miscellaneous Sūtras section of a printed Mongolian Buddhist Kanjur. Only the Chinese marginal title giving the section, volume and folio number could be read. The main Uighur-Mongolian text was not transcribed.</summary>
